reason: Conversation 1 correctly flagged that 'NN-H98' is not a model and H98 is a display code, obtained the full model and grill-status to confirm an inverter/magnetron output fault, tried one reset, and then steered the homeowner to an engineer with sensible UK repair-vs-replace economics and questions to ask the repairer.
